data.camera: cowboy shot, sitting on studio sofa
data.description: 【黑川茜 · 访谈节目】深夜访谈节目的沙发上，黑川茜礼貌地微笑作答，蓝紫长发垂落在围裙裙装的肩线上，摄像头红灯亮起的一瞬她已进入状态——「关于纱姬这个角色……我想说的还有很多。」
data.promptProse: Akane sits on the late-night interview studio sofa in her blue pinafore and white blouse, answering politely as a camera's red recording light comes on. Her blue-purple hair rests along the dress straps in the cowboy view. The sofa arm leads toward the studio set behind her. Broad interview lights illuminate her face and blouse, with softer shadows around the blue fabric and a small reflected red point on nearby camera metal.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 访谈节目
